title: CodexWasmHostContract
description: Draft host ABI contract for the codex-wasm-bridge. Defines every capability the host must provide to the wasm module, plus the wasm module's exported surface the host calls into. All messages use JSON payloads keyed by a correlation_id for request/response matching.

correlation_id.description: Every host request and wasm callback carries a correlation_id. The host MUST echo the same correlation_id when delivering results back to the wasm module. This is the only mechanism for matching async results to pending operations.

cancellation.description: Either side may send a Cancel message referencing a correlation_id. The receiver SHOULD stop work associated with that id and emit a final status with cancelled: true. Cancellation is best-effort; results may still arrive after a cancel is sent.

error_shape.description: All error payloads follow this shape. The host MUST return this shape when a capability is missing, a request fails, or an operation times out.

error.code: string (enum: missing_capability | not_found | permission_denied | timeout | cancelled | internal)

missing_capability.description: If the host does not implement a capability, it MUST return an error with code 'missing_capability' rather than silently dropping the request. The wasm module surfaces this as an explicit user-visible error.

wasm_exports.description: Functions the wasm module MUST export via wasm-bindgen for the host to call.

codex_init.description: Initialize the wasm module with configuration. Must be called before any other method.

codex_submit.description: Submit a request (prompt, tool call, etc.) for processing.

codex_deliver_callback.description: Deliver the result of a host capability call back to the wasm module.

codex_cancel.description: Cancel an in-flight operation by correlation_id.

codex_shutdown.description: Gracefully shut down the wasm module. No further calls should be made after this resolves.

host_imports.description: Functions the host MUST provide as wasm imports. The wasm module calls these to request host capabilities. Each call includes a correlation_id for async result delivery via codex_deliver_callback.

exec.description: Execute a command on the host and stream results back.

fields.data: string (utf-8 text or base64 for binary)

errors: missing_capability: host does not provide exec
not_found: command not found on host
permission_denied: host policy blocks this command

network.description: Perform HTTP requests and deliver responses or streamed chunks.

payload.method: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE | PATCH | HEAD | OPTIONS

callback_payloads.description: Chunk for streamed responses (SSE, chunked transfer).

errors: missing_capability: host does not provide network

filesystem.description: Read, write, list, and stat files on the host filesystem or MEMFS.
errors: missing_capability: host does not provide filesystem
permission_denied: host policy blocks this path

secrets.description: Retrieve and store secrets through the host's credential provider.
errors: missing_capability: host does not provide secret storage
permission_denied: host policy blocks secret access

sandbox.description: Sandbox operations are explicitly stubbed in wasm mode. The host acknowledges sandbox requests but takes no enforcement action.

callback.reason: sandbox is not enforced in wasm mode

lifecycle.description: Expected call sequence for a minimal session.
sequence: host calls codex_submit(request_json) — wasm begins processing
wasm calls host_exec_request / host_http_request / host_fs_read / etc. as needed
wasm completes processing and resolves the codex_submit promise with a result
notes: Multiple codex_submit calls may be in flight concurrently.
Host capability calls are async: wasm sends a request, host delivers the result via callback.
If a host capability is missing, the host MUST return error_shape with code missing_capability.
codex_shutdown waits for in-flight operations to drain or cancel.

extension_interfaces.description: Extension host imports + structured submit keys — keep aligned with codex_core::wasm_extension and codex-wasm-bridge::extension_ids. The wasm kernel routes these payload keys to imports; production hosts may answer missing_capability until brokers exist.

tcp.notes: Likely unavailable in browser hosts; EdgeJS / Node may implement.

app_server_rpc.notes: Carries app-server v2-style JSON-RPC envelopes without compiling codex-app-server into wasm.

host_import_methods.host_websocket_request: WebSocket connect / frame I/O (callbacks TBD; likely network capability family)
host_import_methods.host_app_server_rpc: Forward RPC to native IDE server or worker; response via codex_deliver_callback
